actionCalls.description: Sends the FQS Stewardship Response (Standard) email template to the donor's PersonContact using the emailSimple v3 template-aware action. Stewardship is distinct from acknowledgement: it is a follow-up mission-oriented touch sent after the acknowledgement is already Sent, meant to deepen the donor relationship rather than restate the transaction. recipientId is the PersonContactId; relatedRecordId is the GiftTransaction for merge context.
actionCalls.name: Send_Stewardship_Email
actionCalls.label: Send Stewardship Email (Template)

actionCalls.description: Catch-all fault handler. On any critical element failure, sends $Flow.FaultMessage to the running user's email so errors surface immediately without silently skipping records. Reached via isGoTo fault connectors so a single fault element handles all paths.
actionCalls.name: Send_Fault_Email
actionCalls.label: Send Fault Email

assignments.description: Default branch — reached when neither FQS_Is_Major_Gift__c nor FQS_Is_Mid_Gift__c is TRUE. Covers Entry-threshold gifts and sub-Entry gifts below the one-time minimum. Sets varResolvedTier to Entry and loads the Entry CMDT row's FQS_Auto_Stewardship__c into varAutoStewardshipSetting. Both values drive the Route decision and task-field formulas downstream.
assignments.name: Set_Tier_Entry
assignments.label: Set Tier — Entry

assignments.description: Reached when FQS_Is_Major_Gift__c is TRUE. Sets varResolvedTier to Major and loads the Major CMDT row's FQS_Auto_Stewardship__c into varAutoStewardshipSetting. Major is seeded to Exclude All so this tier always creates a Task for personal stewardship outreach.
assignments.name: Set_Tier_Major
assignments.label: Set Tier — Major

assignments.description: Reached when FQS_Is_Mid_Gift__c is TRUE and FQS_Is_Major_Gift__c is FALSE. Sets varResolvedTier to Mid and loads the Mid CMDT row's FQS_Auto_Stewardship__c into varAutoStewardshipSetting. Mid is seeded to Exclude Lifetime so lifetime Major donors at this tier are escalated to the task path for personal stewardship.
assignments.name: Set_Tier_Mid
assignments.label: Set Tier — Mid

decisions.description: Determines the donor tier for the current GiftTransaction using the pre-calculated formula fields on GiftTransaction. Evaluated in priority order: Major first (highest tier wins), then Mid, then Entry as the default. Sub-Entry gifts — amounts below the Entry one-time minimum where no Is_*_Gift field fires — fall through to Entry. The resolved tier drives varAutoStewardshipSetting, task priority, activity date, and subject.
decisions.name: Resolve_Gift_Tier
decisions.label: Resolve Gift Tier

decisions.description: Central routing decision. Email path requires ALL three conditions: (1) Contact has not opted out of email, (2) CMDT setting for this tier is not Exclude All, and (3) the lifetime-escalation rule does not block — i.e., setting is not Exclude Lifetime OR donor is not yet a lifetime Major donor (frmEmailOkByLifetime). Any single failing condition routes to the Task path. Email opt-out forces Task regardless of CMDT setting, with [OPT-OUT — send by mail] prepended to the task subject by frmTaskSubject.
decisions.name: Route_Email_Or_Task
decisions.label: Route: Email or Task?

Flow.description:
Scheduled flow that runs daily and processes all GiftTransaction records where Status = Paid, AcknowledgementStatus = Sent (only steward gifts that were successfully acknowledged first), TransactionDate is at least 14 days in the past, and FQS_Stewardship_Status__c is blank or To Be Sent. The 14-day gap between acknowledgement and stewardship gives the initial thank-you time to land before the mission-oriented follow-up arrives; the window is tunable.
For each qualifying gift the flow: (1) fetches the donor Account, Contact, and DonorGiftSummary; (2) resolves the gift tier from formula fields on GiftTransaction; (3) loads the FQS_Auto_Stewardship__c setting from the pre-fetched FQS_Donor_Tier__mdt row for that tier (picklist semantics — Include All / Exclude Lifetime / Exclude All — govern stewardship routing; the acknowledgement flow uses a universal rule and does not consult this field); (4) routes to email or task based on the setting, the donor's lifetime tier, and the Contact email opt-out flag; (5) stamps FQS_Stewardship_Status__c accordingly and, on send, FQS_Stewardship_Date__c.
Email path: sends the FQS Stewardship Response (Standard) template via the emailSimple v3 template-aware action to the donor PersonContact; sets FQS_Stewardship_Status__c = Sent and FQS_Stewardship_Date__c = today. Task path: creates a Task owned by the FQS Stewardship Response queue; sets FQS_Stewardship_Status__c = To Be Sent. Queue member completes the personal outreach and closes the task manually, then sets FQS_Stewardship_Status__c = Sent and FQS_Stewardship_Date__c.
Opt-out override: if Contact.HasOptedOutOfEmail is TRUE, the flow always takes the task path. The task subject is prefixed [OPT-OUT — send by mail] so the queue member knows immediately to use a non-email channel.
CMDT rows and the Queue Id are fetched once before the loop to minimise SOQL queries per iteration. Fault connectors on all action and DML elements route to Send_Fault_Email which notifies $User.Email.

formulas.description: Returns TRUE when sending an email is not blocked by the Exclude Lifetime rule. Returns FALSE only when varAutoStewardshipSetting = "Exclude Lifetime" AND the donor is already a lifetime Major donor per DonorGiftSummary.FQS_Is_Major_Lifetime_Donor__c. All other combinations return TRUE. Exclude All is handled separately as condition 2 in Route_Email_Or_Task and never reaches this formula check.
formulas.name: frmEmailOkByLifetime

formulas.description: The date boundary used in the Get_GiftTransactions filter. Only gifts whose TransactionDate is on or before this date are included, preserving the 14-day gap between the acknowledgement touch and the stewardship touch so the initial thank-you lands cleanly before the mission-oriented follow-up.
formulas.name: frmFourteenDaysAgo

formulas.description: Sets the task due date relative to today. Major: +3 days (prompt personal stewardship touch). Mid: +7 days. Entry: +14 days. These windows give queue members reasonable SLAs scaled to the significance of the gift.
formulas.name: frmTaskActivityDate

formulas.description: Populates the task Description with context the queue member needs to personalise the stewardship outreach: the donor's lifetime giving tier name and whether email is blocked.
formulas.name: frmTaskDescription

formulas.description: Sets Task.Priority based on gift tier. Major gifts are High priority to prompt immediate personal stewardship outreach. Mid and Entry gifts are Normal priority.
formulas.name: frmTaskPriority

formulas.description: Builds the task subject. Prepends [OPT-OUT — send by mail] when the donor has opted out of email so the queue member immediately knows to use a non-email channel. Format: [opt-out prefix] Steward [Tier] gift: [Donor Name] — $[Amount].
formulas.name: frmTaskSubject

Flow.label: FQS Stewardship Response

loops.description: Iterates over all qualifying GiftTransaction records returned by Get_GiftTransactions. For each record: fetches the donor Account, Contact, and DonorGiftSummary; resolves the gift tier; then routes to the email or task path. Both terminal update elements (Update_GT_Stewardship_Sent and Update_GT_Stewardship_To_Be_Sent) connect back here so the loop advances to the next record automatically.
loops.name: Loop_GiftTransactions
loops.label: Loop: Gift Transactions to Steward

recordCreates.description: Creates the personal-outreach Task assigned to the FQS Stewardship Response queue (Id fetched pre-loop). WhoId is the donor PersonContactId so the task appears on the Contact timeline. Subject, Priority, ActivityDate, and Description are all formula-driven and vary by tier and opt-out status.
recordCreates.name: Create_Stewardship_Task
recordCreates.label: Create Stewardship Task

recordLookups.description: Fetches the PersonContact for the donor Account. HasOptedOutOfEmail is the opt-out signal in Route_Email_Or_Task — TRUE forces the task path regardless of CMDT setting. Email and name fields are available for the template via the recipientId binding.
recordLookups.name: Get_Contact
recordLookups.label: Get Donor Contact

recordLookups.description: Fetches the donor Account for the current loop GiftTransaction. PersonContactId is required for the email recipient and task WhoId. Account.Name populates the task subject via frmTaskSubject.
recordLookups.name: Get_Donor_Account
recordLookups.label: Get Donor Account

recordLookups.description: Fetches the DonorGiftSummary for the current donor. FQS_Is_Major_Lifetime_Donor__c feeds frmEmailOkByLifetime — it controls the Exclude Lifetime escalation that routes lifetime Major donors at the Mid tier to the task path. FQS_Lifetime_Donor_Level_Name__c populates the task Description so queue members have full lifetime context for the stewardship outreach.
recordLookups.name: Get_DonorGiftSummary
recordLookups.label: Get Donor Gift Summary

recordLookups.description: Fetches the FQS_Donor_Tier__mdt record for the Entry tier before the loop starts. FQS_Auto_Stewardship__c is read by Set_Tier_Entry inside the loop; picklist semantics (Include All / Exclude Lifetime / Exclude All) govern stewardship routing. Fetching once pre-loop avoids one SOQL call per iteration.
recordLookups.name: Get_Entry_CMDT
recordLookups.label: Get Entry Tier CMDT Row

recordLookups.description: Queries all GiftTransaction records that qualify for stewardship outreach: Status = Paid, AcknowledgementStatus = Sent (only steward gifts that were successfully acknowledged first), TransactionDate on or before frmFourteenDaysAgo (today minus 14 days), FQS_Stewardship_Status__c blank or To Be Sent, and FQS_Gift_Transaction_Category__c != Other (never steward earned income / event registration / fee records). Records with FQS_Stewardship_Status__c = Sent or Don't Send are excluded. Results feed Loop_GiftTransactions.
recordLookups.name: Get_GiftTransactions
recordLookups.label: Get Gift Transactions to Steward

recordLookups.description: Fetches the FQS_Donor_Tier__mdt record for the Major tier before the loop starts. FQS_Auto_Stewardship__c is read by Set_Tier_Major inside the loop; picklist semantics govern stewardship routing. Fetching once pre-loop avoids one SOQL call per iteration.
recordLookups.name: Get_Major_CMDT
recordLookups.label: Get Major Tier CMDT Row

recordLookups.description: Fetches the FQS_Donor_Tier__mdt record for the Mid tier before the loop starts. FQS_Auto_Stewardship__c is read by Set_Tier_Mid inside the loop; picklist semantics govern stewardship routing. Fetching once pre-loop avoids one SOQL call per iteration.
recordLookups.name: Get_Mid_CMDT
recordLookups.label: Get Mid Tier CMDT Row

recordLookups.description: Fetches the FQS_Stewardship_Response queue Group record by DeveloperName so its Id can be used as Task.OwnerId in Create_Stewardship_Task inside the loop. Fetching once pre-loop avoids one SOQL call per iteration. If the queue does not exist the fault path surfaces the error before the loop starts.
recordLookups.name: Get_Queue_Id
recordLookups.label: Get FQS Stewardship Response Queue

recordUpdates.description: Stamps FQS_Stewardship_Status__c = Sent and FQS_Stewardship_Date__c = today on the current GiftTransaction after the stewardship email has been dispatched. Filter on Id ensures only this loop record is updated. Connects back to Loop_GiftTransactions so the next record is processed.
recordUpdates.name: Update_GT_Stewardship_Sent
recordUpdates.label: Update GT — Stewardship Sent

recordUpdates.description: Stamps FQS_Stewardship_Status__c = To Be Sent on the current GiftTransaction after the personal-outreach Task has been created. Signals that the gift is in the manual stewardship queue awaiting a queue member. The queue member sets FQS_Stewardship_Status__c = Sent and FQS_Stewardship_Date__c after completing the outreach. Connects back to Loop_GiftTransactions so the next record is processed.
recordUpdates.name: Update_GT_Stewardship_To_Be_Sent
recordUpdates.label: Update GT — Stewardship Pending (To Be Sent)

variables.description: Holds the FQS_Auto_Stewardship__c value from the CMDT row for the current gift's resolved tier. Assigned by Set_Tier_Major/Mid/Entry at the start of each loop iteration from the pre-fetched CMDT record variables. Picklist semantics (Include All / Exclude Lifetime / Exclude All) govern stewardship routing. Default is Include All so a missing CMDT row results in email rather than silently skipping the gift.
variables.name: varAutoStewardshipSetting

variables.description: Holds the resolved gift tier string (Major, Mid, or Entry) for the current loop iteration. Drives frmTaskPriority, frmTaskActivityDate, and frmTaskSubject. Assigned by Set_Tier_Major/Mid/Entry in Resolve_Gift_Tier. Default is Entry so sub-Entry gifts (where no Is_*_Gift formula field fires) follow Entry tier rules.
variables.name: varResolvedTier
